quoteDispatch(bytes,bytes).details: The returned quote is denominated in a single currency - either native ETH (when metadata.feeToken is address(0) or unspecified) or an ERC-20 token (when metadata.feeToken is set). Mixing fee denominations within a single dispatch is not supported. When feeToken is set, hooks that only support native fees should return 0 or revert via supportsMetadata. The Mailbox.quoteDispatch sums quotes from requiredHook and hook, which assumes both use the same denomination.
